title: BUG: Trace Bitmap marching-squares drops ~half of every non-rectangular region (open contour)
description:
DEFECT in packages/core/src/engine/bitmapTrace.ts marchingSquaresContour() (added task 1220, commit 1d27ff3). The contour walker correctly traces axis-aligned rectangles but produces an OPEN / incomplete contour for any region whose boundary has both right- and left-leaning diagonal edges — i.e. essentially every curved or rotated region (circles, diamonds, ellipses, the Magnet.fla trace-bitmap vector logos that are the headline use case per CLAUDE.md). The walk goes around one side, reaches the far tip, then walks UP the interior line of symmetry and terminates at ~start, enclosing only ~half the true area.

EVIDENCE (run against freshly-built packages/core/dist via the now-exported internals):
- 40x40 filled disk (R=18): raw contour area=523, true area~1018 (HALF). Traced ShapePath bounding box is x=20..39 (RIGHT HALF only); should be x~2..38. So a traced circle renders/compiles as a half-disk.
- Minimal repro DIAMOND5 (|x-2|+|y-2|<=2 on 5x5 grid, 13 filled cells): marchingSquaresContour returns 14 verts, shoelace area=9 (expected 13). Contour walk:
  (2,0)->(3,0)->(3,1)->(4,1)->(4,2)->(5,2)->(5,3)->(4,3)->(4,4)->(3,4)->(3,5)->(2,5)->(2,4)->(2,3) then STOPS. It traces the right half then climbs the x=2 chord and quits; x<2 (left half) is never visited.
- Other failing shapes: r=5 circle (cells 81, area 46), plus/cross (cells 45, area 36), ring (cells 208, area 136). Passing only: axis-aligned rectangles (SQUARE6 area 36 OK) and one lucky right-triangle.

ROOT CAUSE: the direction chosen at each grid vertex (switch on caseIdx, bitmapTrace.ts:229-275) depends almost entirely on the 2x2 cell config and ignores the entry/travel direction except for the two literal saddle cases (5,10). The classic marching-squares boundary walk must keep the filled region consistently on one side using the ENTRY direction to disambiguate the single-column / single-row configs; the current table sends the walker up the interior chord at a bottom tip instead of around the outside. Needs a Moore-neighbor / consistent-handedness rewrite (track travel direction, turn so fill stays on a fixed side), not a per-case lookup.

WHY UNIT TESTS MISSED IT: src/engine/__tests__/bitmapTrace.test.ts and src/model/__tests__/traceBitmap.test.ts only assert axis-aligned rectangles, a single pixel, and one 3x3 L (all of whose boundaries lack an up-left diagonal), so they never exercise the broken path. Add diagonal/convex regression cases (diamond, disk) asserting shoelace area ~= filled-cell count and that the contour bbox matches the region bbox.

Closure invariant itself is fine: polygonToShapePath always appends a final segment back to start and sets closed:true, so Douglas-Peucker does not break closure — the geometry is just half-missing. SWF compile of the (wrong) shape succeeds (valid DefineShape, 124 bytes), so this is a geometry-correctness bug, not a crash.

SCOPE: packages/core/src/engine/bitmapTrace.ts + its two test files only. Acceptance: traced disk/diamond contour area within a few % of filled-cell count; traced bbox == region bbox; Magnet.fla traced logos render as full shapes.
